notes.title: Yerr Out 1.0.7 just released!
notes.content:
A few non-gameplay features are in this update:

-NEW draft mode "DUPLICATES" where you can select the same character multiple times 
    * available in offline matches and online custom matches

-Animal cards are now graded and this grade is shown in the bottom corner of the card
    * Common -- Uncommon -- Rare -- Super Rare -- Legendary

-NEW "Card Packs"  currently $2.99 each
    * packs will include 5 random cards (characters + skins)




==========================================================
==========================================================

...Roadmap features coming next:

NEW FIELDS! 
   -there are 7 new fields that have been in development and looking amazing so far, would like to release 3 of them this Fall

NEW ANIMALS! 
   -this will probably come later on with the remaining 4 fields, eta Spring 2026. This would also include a restructure to the draft board

NEW ONLINE MINIGAME MODE
   -this has been close to ready but dev on it stalled out to prioritize the other items. Would like to include this with the 3 new fields in a Fall update


NEW STORY MODE (Part 2)
   -likely waayy too much of a stretch anytime soon... Once the new fields/animals/minigame are released sometime by next year, the decision would be to keep adding more animals/modes or start developing a completely new title (Yerr Out Football? Yerr Out Chessball?) 



==========================================================
==========================================================

...One more note:

Yerr Out has been approved for:
-Steam's Animal Fest! (November 10-17) 
-Steam's Sports Fest! (December 8-15) 

Not sure there will be any promos, but be sure to tell everyone you know where they can quench their thirst for some animal sports gaming. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Yerr Out 1.0.6 just released!
notes.content:
New improvements to fielding QOL such as camera, autoselect, status indicators, and dive recovery response

There is also:
- CPU difficulty selection
- buff/nerfs to some characters
- overall bug fixes
...plus more!


vvv  - Full patch notes below -  vvv

Fielding changes:
- fielding camera zoomed out and leads in front of ball more
- fielder autoselect better on flyballs between infield and outfield
- new hover status fx
- better responsiveness after fielder dive -> start throw


Other gameplay changes:
- add force feedback (rumble) for some new events (ex. error, tagged out, etc)
- improve some characters' swing animations
- tweak scaling on batter moveSpeed slowdown while charging
- Gauntlet: minigames require a medal (bronze/silver/gold) score to pass


New features:
- can now choose CPU difficulty in local matches


Buff/nerfs:
- characters with very low throwAccuracy or fieldingRange (TECHNIQUE) were slightly buffed
- a few select characters got minor buffs/nerfs as well


Bug fixes:
- in certain modes/situations the pitcher couldn't move after a pickoff
- Gauntlet: mashing (A) in some situations would cause issues
- added CITY field back into online game modes (lmk if it crashes)

notes.title: Yerr Out v1.0.5
notes.content:
Big update for Custom Lobbies: introducing Co-op matches!

Get the whole squad together because...
Yerr Out online lobbies can now hold up to 8 players!

Which means that Co-op matches are now possible as well!
|  2v2  |  3v3  |  4v4  |  ... and everything in between


Other notable changes in this update:

 new UI showing current at-bat info
 improved fielder autoSelect
 tweaked batter launch angle/velo for balls hit off the edge towards foul territory
 changed mercy rule from 15 -> 12

notes.title: Yerr Out v1.0.4
notes.content:
The most-requested feature is finally here... Custom Lobbies!

You can now create a custom lobby for your friends or randos to join. In this lobby, the host can start a match and choose the match settings. These matches are considered "unranked" so you don't have to worry about your record every time when playing online

To join your friend's lobby, use either the in-game UI or the Steam overlay (Shift+Tab). 
When joining thru the Steam overlay, make sure you already have Yerr Out running. Then right-click your friend's name and select "Join Game"

You can also use the Steam overlay to send a lobby invite. In the Steam overlay, right-click your friend's name and select "Invite to Game"



Other changes in this update:


 improved selectedFielder ring fx
 cleaned up more character animations

notes.title: Yerr Out v1.0.3
notes.content:
This update contains a lot of subtle, wide-sweeping changes to gameplay - along with some visual updates to the playing fields

The changes are expected to have a big impact on character tier lists, by helping some of the neglected heavy characters swing big and be more viable, and also by cleaning up some animations for certain characters

Changes include:

 hitting engine which determines launch angle/power based off hit contact
 pitching speed and curve

 character attributes
 character animations (batting, throwing) have been cleaned up
  Some characters with the most notable changes/buffs include:
         hippo, giraffe, mouse, spider, beetle, ant, ostrich, bear, and a lot of the secret characters


 tweaked the bounce and friction for some fields
 optimize fps for some fields

 when fielding, sometimes mashing (A) while diving and grabbing the ball could result in weird behavior or the ball getting stuck, this should be much improved now
 the pitcher covers 1B quicker after a hit
 each field has its own ball trail fx, instead of red/blue for each team
 the timer for Scramble Drill now waits until the ball touches the ground or a fielder before starting

 CPU batting and fielding improved

notes.title: Yerr Out 1.0 Official Release is now live! 🚨🚨🚨
notes.content:
🚨 Yerr Out 1.0 Official Release! 🚨

Download now for FREE while supplies last ⚾

New features include:

 6 brand new fields
 over 100 animals to unlock
 minigames, practice modes, story mode, online PvP
 improved UI for viewing character stats

🐊🐘🐈


Join Discord for the latest news and chatter
https://discord.com/invite/tS46Ze9ccj



Wow!

This version has exceeded my expectations in many ways with the new fields and amount of characters. It's been a lot of fun working on this and hope that players love it too. Excited to see what others think and hear feedback. After so much internal playtesting, it's hard to have a fresh perspective. Tried to really dial everything in for this version, but as more games get played, expecting to make minor tweaks to things like character balancing and hitting engine

Down the road, expect there to be seasonal events, tournaments, promotions, etc. With new character releases as prizes

⚾ Looking forward to playing some online PvP
